verdict.rationale: Working Copy connects straight to a user-supplied repository URL over ssh, git, https or http. Its docs describe setting up a regular Linux server, BSD server or Synology NAS as a hosting provider using SSH commands, and it supports self-hosted GitHub Enterprise, GitLab and Gitea. Missing for 10: no explicit statement that traffic never passes through a vendor relay or proxy, no guidance on reaching servers on private networks without a VPN, no independent or hands-on corroboration of direct self-hosted connections.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can connect directly to my servers without relying on a cloud relay, proxy, or VPN

citations.quote: Press + on the list of repositories and provide a URL pointing to your repository. Working Copy supports https, ssh, git, and http protocols.
configure a regular Linux server, BSD server & Synology NAS to act as a hosting provider, using SSH commands for listing repositories.
Working Copy supports private instances of GitHub Enterprise, GitLab and Gitea.
